verdict.rationale: Sift publishes its API reference by dated version (v205/v204/v203, with versioned URLs) and keeps a dated changelog that explicitly marks fields as 'Deprecated'. It also documents a migration path off the legacy Sift Score. The evidence shows deprecations being announced, but no formal deprecation policy stating notice periods, sunset timelines or support windows for older versions. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines and support guarantees, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The API reference is published per dated version (v205/v204/v203 selectable; versioned URL pattern /docs/v205/...)
Migrate off the legacy Sift Score to get more accurate, abuse-specific risk scores.
